findings.proof: BattleTryRun declares u8 run; raw speed >= opponent guarantees success; slower branch computes old runAttempts, truncates to u8, compares run>random%256, increments attempts afterward. Browser increments before, uses > speed and unbounded numeric odds. Equal legal raw speed is a direct witness; no unsupported ability required.
findings.fixBoundary: Preserve raw-speed comparison and supported status handling; do not replace it with stage/paralysis effectiveSpeed or add unimplemented ability/item mechanics.

findings.fixBoundary: Only correct existing burn integer order; do not silently add Guts/screens/weather/other currently unported modifiers.

findings.proof: Mom choice saves FLAG_SYS_MOMS_SAVINGS but trainer reward always adds full prize and State has no savings balance.
